page_title: CAG 1-1 FIO | Cagliari v Fiorentina 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+7' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+6' Simone Sozza blows for a foul after Yerry Mina (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

90+4' 1 - 1 Perfectly taken free kick! Gianluca Gaetano sends the ball in, Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
90+2' The Cagliari players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
88' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
85' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.
85' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

83' David de Gea makes a brilliant save! Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
82' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
81' Substitution. Gennaro Borrelli is replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
80' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
79' Fiorentina earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
79' The whistle blows and Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) is booked for an infringement.
77' Substitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) has come on for Robin Gosens.
76' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
76' Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
75' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Fabio Pisacane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) replacing Adam Obert.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Deiola departs the field of play to be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
74' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacopo Fazzini (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Albert Gudmundsson can be given a rest.
72' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
71' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) earns the yellow card.

68' 0 - 1 Albert Gudmundsson displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it in off the left post – 0:1.

66' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and David de Gea pulls off an easy save.
64' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) strikes a thunderbolt from a long-range free kick, but the effort goes well wide of the left post. It's going to be a goal kick.
64' Simone Sozza interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pablo Mari (Fiorentina). A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pietro Comuzzo leaves the pitch and Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) comes on.
61' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli (Cagliari) replaces Matteo Prati.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastiano Esposito.
58' Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul after Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) hacks down one of his opponents.
56' What a huge chance for Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
55' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is penalised for holding. Simone Sozza signals a set piece.
51' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) heads on.
51' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
50' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
46' Half-time substitution. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) is replaced by Rolando Mandragora.
46' Stefano Pioli makes a switch. Mattia Viti is coming on in place of Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' It looks like Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
43' Adam Obert (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
41' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
40' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
37' Dodo (Fiorentina) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
35' The game is interrupted now, Dodo (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
31' Referee Simone Sozza sees the trip by Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

30' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
27' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
27' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Adam Obert (Cagliari) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
22' The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
21' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Cagliari win a corner.
19' A precise low pass is received by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
14' A corner kick by Cagliari is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).
13' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
9' Adam Obert (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Simone Sozza saw the whole situation.
6' Gennaro Borrelli (Cagliari) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simone Sozza has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
1' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) picks up an injury.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
